title: DT Adetomiwa Adebawore agrees to two-year extension with Colts

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: DT Adetomiwa Adebawore agrees to two-year extension with Colts
sources.description: The Colts took a break from working on trading away players ahead of next Tuesday's deadline to assure that one member of the team will be sticking around for a while.
